name: P3⊕P4 benchmark
description: Single-command benchmark (PINN-Navier/DEM, OIR-Ridge/DeepONet on a fixed Kuramoto reservoir, CST physical solver, k-NN/RF/RFF controls), the six fibre-node datasets M1–M6, the controlled synthetic experiments (matrix-sampling prescription and structural-disorder sweep) and the raw RTX 4060 results of the manuscript submitted to Computational Materials Science (2026). Version 1.3 adds the boundary-noise and predicted-boundary controls of the CST reconstruction (src/boundary_noise.py, tables/boundary_noise.json).
